summary: Tested role-based login redirects, RoleRoute URL isolation for 4 roles, owner-only /compliance (frontend + backend), Compliance tab in Owner panel, collapsible sidebar sections + Classes child toggle, Settings nav toggles (per-user + school defaults), a11y-menu Settings link, session persistence on refresh. Backend 13/13 pytest passed. Frontend: everything works except one bug — toggling a section off in /settings persists (PATCH 200) but the sidebar does not update live; it only disappears after navigating/reloading.

minor.issue: Username is interpolated into a Mongo $regex without re.escape (e.g. identifier '.*' with a known password pattern could match unintended users; also regex chars in usernames break matching). Use re.escape(username_or_email).

Owner's 'school-wide default' is saved under the owner's school_id or 'global'. Users with a school_id read their own school's doc, so the owner's default never reaches school users — only school_admin of each school can set it. Confirm whether that is intended. Keys are also not validated against learn/teach/school/account.
Accepts arbitrary keys (no whitelist of section keys).

ui_bugs.issue: When you toggle a section in Settings (e.g. toggle-nav-teach off), the PATCH succeeds and shows the 'Navigation updated' toast, but [data-testid=sn-section-teach] stays in the sidebar until you navigate to another page or reload. Cause: SideNav fetches /me/nav-prefs only once in useEffect([user]), and Settings has no way to tell SideNav the prefs changed. Fix: keep nav prefs in shared context/state, or dispatch a window event (e.g. 'nav-prefs-changed') from Settings that SideNav listens for. Apply the same fix to school defaults.

issues: Shows Teach/School toggles to roles that never have those sections (parent only has Account). Filter NAV_SECTIONS to the sections that buildNav actually returns for the role.
Pinned 'Home' and brand link go to /dashboard, not the parent's home /parent. Consider using homeForRole(user.role).

action_items: Make the SideNav update live after Settings nav-prefs / school-default changes (shared context or custom event).
Clarify and fix how the owner's school-wide nav defaults reach school users (right now they are scoped to the owner's own school_id/'global').
Optional: whitelist nav section keys on the backend; hide irrelevant toggles per role; make the parent's Home link go to /parent.
critical_code_review_comments: SideNav.jsx: nav prefs are local state fetched once, with no refresh path.
server.py login_username: unescaped user input passed to $regex.
server.py _school_settings_doc: the owner's default is keyed by the owner's school_id, so it is not a true platform-wide default.
RoleRoute ignores AuthContext loading, but this is fine because user is hydrated synchronously from localStorage. Refresh persistence verified.
seed_data_creation: None. The tests restore the owner's nav_prefs. The test may also have written nav_section_defaults {school: true} on the owner's school_settings doc, which is the same as the default.

Individual bounced from /owner,/compliance,/teacher,/owner/payouts to /dashboard. Parent bounced from /teacher,/owner,/compliance to /parent. Tester1 bounced from /owner,/compliance,/owner/payouts to /teacher. Owner /compliance direct and the Owner tab-compliance both show compliance-page. a11y-settings-link goes to /settings. Section collapse and sn-classes-toggle work. Retest live sidebar update after the fix.
